summary: syrrrun.com is Jolly Acres' own site (same name, address 289 Horne Taylor Rd, phone 843-563-8303), not a different business. Confirmed 30/50 A with water and sewer, all pull-through, laundry, Wi-Fi, Good Sam and military discounts. Cleared the derived site count and dump station (directory-only). Fees left as recorded ($42 30 A / $45 50 A; page undated). Note trimmed; '12 pull-through' dropped (operator: all pull-through).
flags: Rate date: the operator's rate page (http://www.syrrrun.com/our-services.html, 'Nightly fee: $ 42 - 30 amp electricity / $ 45 - 50 amp') carries no date (site footer '© 2013'); it is the current posted rate as read 2026-10-21 but not dated 2024+. Under the US$50 gate either way. No booking engine ('RESERVATIONS PREFERRED', call 843-563-8303). Extra $3 a person a night over 4 people.

Presence passes: working operator website with phone 843-563-8303 (matches the entry). No gateway within 40 km (Charleston 70 km); the family has not stayed here. Long-stay tests: a nightly rate is posted alongside weekly/monthly ('call for prices'); nothing suggests seasonal-only sites.
